newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OCBC's Malaysian broking unit to list.
newsitem.headline: OCBC's Malaysian broking unit to list.

text.p: OCBC Bank said on Tuesday its stockbroking interest in Malaysia held through TCL Premier Holdings Bhd is seeking a listing on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
OCBC said in a statement the TCL listing will involve an issue of 12.5 million new shares and an offer of 12.5 million ordinary shares to the public at an offer price of 2.50 ringgit each a share.
With the enlarged share capital of TCL after the issue of the new shares, OCBC will hold 30 percent of the company, it said.
